abstract: A sandwich-type enzyme immunoassay system specific for human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) was prepared with the antibody Fab'-beta-D-galactosidase complex and the antibody F(ab')2-immobilized silicone rubber solid phase by using a purified antibody to beta subunit of hCG (hCG beta). The assay system cross-reacted less than 4% with human luteinizing hormone (hLH) and human follicular stimulating hormone (hFSH), and proved to be highly sensitive with hCG measurable at levels as low as 0.3 mIU per assay tube. Using 50 microliter of serum sample, 6-600 mIU/ml of hCG in serum could be determined specifically with the same degree of precision as in radioimmunoassay but without sample interference with the assay. The coefficients of variation within-run and between-run were 8.6-8.9%, and 4.9-10.7%, respectively. Values obtained with the enzyme immunoassay correlated well with those of radioimmunoassay (r = 0.98, slope = 0.94, y-intercept = 10.2 mIU/ml for 75 serum samples). Results of the immunoassay of hCG levels in serial samples of serum from healthy women and patients with choriocarcinoma show that this method is useful in the clinical diagnosis of trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: hCGのβサブユニットに対する精製抗体を用い、抗体Fab'-β-D-ガラクトシダーゼ複合体と抗体F(ab')2固定化シリコーンゴム固相を用いて、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に特異的なサンドイッチ型酵素免疫測定系を作製した。この測定系はヒト黄体形成ホルモン(hLH)およびヒト卵胞刺激ホルモン(hFSH)との交差反応が4%未満であり、きわめて高感度であった。hCGは1測定チューブあたり0.3 mIUという低濃度まで測定可能であった。50μLの血清試料を用いて、放射免疫測定法と同等の精度で血清中の6〜600 mIU/mLのhCGを特異的に測定でき、試料による干渉はみられなかった。測定内変動係数は8.6〜8.9%、測定間変動係数は4.9〜10.7%であった。酵素免疫測定法による値は、75例の血清試料で放射免疫測定法と良好に相関した(r = 0.98、傾き0.94、切片10.2 mIU/mL)。健康な女性および絨毛癌患者の血清連続試料での測定結果から、本法は絨毛性疾患の臨床診断に有用であることが示された。
